title: Achieve 80%+ code coverage
description:
Achieved 70.17% coverage (up from 62.73%). Created comprehensive tests for AcdcAuthManager (14 tests) and AuthInterceptor (22 tests). Refactored AuthInterceptor and AcdcAuthManager to support dependency injection for better testability. 

Remaining work to reach 80% tracked in dependencies:
- OAuth refresh HTTP calls need integration tests or more sophisticated mocking
- Token revocation HTTP calls need similar approach

Key achievement: Code is now much more testable with proper DI pattern. The 8 sub-tasks provide clear roadmap to 80%.

title: Fix DIP violation: Abstract JwtUtils dependency in cache_interceptor.dart
Respect ETag header in cache behavior
description: Modify the caching mechanism to respect the ETag HTTP header. When a response contains an ETag, it should be stored. Subsequent requests for the same resource should include the If-None-Match header with the stored ETag. If the server returns 304 Not Modified, the cached response should be used. If 200 OK is returned, the cache should be updated.

title: Refactor AuthInterceptor: Create OAuthTokenRefreshStrategy

title: Add test for non-standard HTTP status codes
description: According to the error-handling spec, scenario 'Non-standard status codes': When non-standard status codes are received (e.g., 418 I'm a teapot, 451 Unavailable For Legal Reasons, 599), they should be categorized by status code range: 4xx → AcdcClientException, 5xx → AcdcServerException, Other → AcdcClientException (fallback). The message should include 'Unexpected status code {code}: {reason}'. This test is currently missing.

title: Add test for OAuth 2.1 refresh request format and parameters
description: According to the authentication spec, scenario 'Refresh request construction': Token refresh requests should be POST to the refresh endpoint with application/x-www-form-urlencoded content type and include: (1) grant_type=refresh_token (required), (2) refresh_token=<token> (required), (3) client_id=<configured-client-id> (required). Should NOT include client_secret (mobile apps are public clients). A FakeOAuthServer helper exists in test/helpers/ but isn't currently used. Need a test that verifies these exact parameters are sent correctly.

Stale-While-Revalidate Implementation.

## Proposal
# Change: Add Stale-While-Revalidate Caching

## Why
Stale-while-revalidate allows apps to show data instantly from the cache while updating it in the background, providing the best perceived performance and data freshness.

## What Changes
- Add `staleWhileRevalidate` policy to `CacheConfig`
- Implement background revalidation logic in `CacheInterceptor` or utilize `dio_cache_interceptor` capabilities
- Support streaming responses (emit stale, then fresh)

## Impact
- Affected specs: `caching`
... (see proposal.md for full text)

## Scenarios to Implement

- Standard Future behavior (Optimistic)
- Reactive Updates (Stream)

title: Implement Request Deduplication (add-request-deduplication)
description:
Request Deduplication Implementation.

## Proposal
# Change: Add Request Deduplication

## Why
Prevents redundant network calls when multiple components request the same resource simultaneously (e.g., fetching user profile on startup).

## What Changes
- Implement `DeduplicationInterceptor`
- Add deduplication logic based on request key (Method + URI + Options + Headers + Data)
- Exclude `CancelToken` from key
- Disable deduplication for `ResponseType.stream`
- Return `Future` that resolves to the result of the in-flight request for duplicates
-... (see proposal.md for full text)

## Scenarios to Implement
- Concurrent GET requests
- Sequential requests
- Non-idempotent requests
- Stream Requests
- Primary Cancellation
- Secondary Cancellation
- Configuration

## Reference
Spec file: `openspec/changes/add-request-deduplication/specs/http-client/spec.md`
